## Findings
- claim-1: Under the stipulated integral box/Schur/Pieri presentation with \(i,j\ge2\), \(q=i+p\), \(r=j+c\), \(p,c\ge1\), \(\min(p,c)=1\), and \(d=ij\), \[ J_d=\mathbb Zx_0,\quad J_{d+1}=\mathbb Z\{x_1,y_1\},\quad J_{d+2}=\mathbb Z\{\gamma,x_2,z,y_2,\theta\}, \] omitting \(\gamma\) when \(p=1\) and \(\theta\) when \(c=1\). Here \(\gamma,\theta\) cannot both be available.
- claim-2: With \(A_1=\langle h_1\rangle\), \(A_2=\langle h_2,h_1^2\rangle\), and \(A_3=\langle h_3,h_2h_1,h_1^3\rangle\), and rows \[ r_2=h_2x_1,\ r_3=h_2y_1,\ r_4=h_1\gamma,\ r_5=h_1x_2,\ r_6=h_1z,\ r_7=h_1y_2,\ r_8=h_1\theta, \] distributivity and the degree-\(d+1,d+2\) Pieri identities give \[ h_2h_1x_0=r_2+r_3,\qquad h_1^3x_0=r_4+r_5+2r_6+r_7+r_8, \] \[ h_1^2x_1=r_4+r_5+r_6,\qquad h_1^2y_1=r_6+r_7+r_8. \]
- claim-3: The required fifteen-case table (4)—including case conditions, available-column orders, selected-row convention, and intended \(R_{\mathrm{full}}\)—is absent from the supplied record; therefore fifteen literal products \(\mathcal C R_{\mathrm{selected}}=R_{\mathrm{full}}\) cannot be displayed or verified without invention.
## Strategy
Use accepted child repair `research-attempt-research-plan-task-70-1`: it establishes that the required fifteen-case table (4) is absent. Thus the requested literal matrix certificates cannot be reconstructed without invention.

The lower-degree descriptions and row dependencies may be conditionally checked after explicitly defining \(J\), slots, integral spans, and zero-row conventions \(r_4=0\) for \(p=1\), \(r_8=0\) for \(c=1\); this does not supply the fifteen products.

## Gaps
The exact fifteen case conditions, ordered available columns, selected rows, \(R_{\mathrm{selected}}\), \(R_{\mathrm{full}}\), and integral matrices \(\mathcal C\) are unavailable. Hence no literal identities
\[
\mathcal C R_{\mathrm{selected}}=R_{\mathrm{full}}
\]
can be displayed or verified.

Accordingly, the bounded exhaustiveness certificate is **not established**.
